name: LiteLLM
help: LiteLLM (https://www.litellm.ai) is an open-source AI gateway: one OpenAI-compatible address, with one key, for many providers. Use the address of your proxy; Totem also looks for one on this computer at port 4000. Add the key of the proxy if it has one. For a model of Ollama behind it, write it as ollama_chat/<model> in the config of LiteLLM.
